prompt:

Asset type: photographic raster background for a fundraising benefit card on UAIN landing page.
Primary request: Create one cinematic realistic Earth connectivity photograph closely matching the reference image, reformatted as a natural portrait 1024 by 1280 pixel canvas. Reference image is visual guidance for subject, geography, colors and glowing arcs, not an edit target.
Scene: Earth seen from orbit above Europe at night with detailed recognizable geography, warm city lights, a brilliant luminous blue atmospheric horizon, starry deep navy sky, warm sunlight just above the horizon towards the upper right.
Composition: Keep the Earth imagery and light arcs entirely in the upper 60 percent of the portrait. A very luminous blue-white central hub over Europe sends thin elegant glowing blue arcs towards other lit cities across Europe and adjacent regions. Central hub is the brightest connection point; arcs rise naturally above the Earth's curvature and land on city lights. Bottom 40 percent smoothly fades to a rich almost uniform deep navy #08283f suitable for long white HTML text, with only a subtle slightly lighter blue at the bottom edge, matching the selected card reference style. No hard boundary where imagery fades into dark lower region.
Style: polished cinematic realistic space photography, high quality detailed textures, subtle restrained blue glow, atmospheric depth, natural geography.
Constraints: No text, typography, letters, logos, watermark, buttons, badges, interface, card border or rounded frame. This is image only; all title and body copy will be HTML overlays. No bright lights or busy details in the lower 40 percent. Deliver one portrait image at exactly 1024x1280; do not squash, stretch or distort the globe.
